scope: one independent GPT-5.6 Sol high methodological review of the proposed next research plan, followed by local critical synthesis

authorization.basis: The user explicitly requested an independent GPT-5.6 Sol review and permanently authorized sanitized research records to OpenAI.
authorization.data_scope: aggregate benchmark results and a research design; no item-level records, sealed references, adjudication artifacts, defect IDs, local paths or project provenance

local_synthesis_contract: Classify each material review recommendation as accepted, modified or rejected with a concrete reason.
Do not defer to reviewer identity, severity wording or volume of criticism.
Preserve the original plan and raw review; never rewrite them to match the synthesis.
Produce a revised plan with explicit sequencing, sample design, analysis, go/no-go gates and stopping rules.
